cases.title: Red Slouch Shoulder Bag
cases.purpose: Bag probe: test whether only the bag changes.
cases.finding: Bag V2 drew the red shoulder bag well, but it made a new picture around it: a gallery background, a green dress in place of the white tee and jeans, and a new pose. Its documentation describes preset styles, chosen at random by default, and a fixed output size. That cannot show a shopper's own bag on them, and each bag would come with a different outfit, so the comparison would not be fair. The other three bags did not run, and Rechoice compares bags by their catalog details only.

checks.note: No validated automated product-detail check for this category.

limits: All current outcomes are development cases already inspected or used while building the checks. There are zero held-out outcomes.
Measurements are recomputed from committed public JPEGs, so they can differ from earlier full-resolution private-pilot readings.
Garment colour and relative earring size are narrow checks, not an overall preview-accuracy score. The reference earring is excluded from the size denominator.
Applied-shade readings are uncalibrated. No shade accuracy or visible-requested-change success rate is claimed.

Outside-region pixel change uses fixed approximate boxes, a 256-pixel working image and threshold 40. It is exploratory, not a face-identity, pose or background-preservation verdict; no pass threshold is defined.
The ten existing clothes reviews were written by an AI assistant, were not blind, and are separate from any new rubric ratings. No independent human review is implied.
The rejected bag probe is included. The rejected necklace result and unpublished private pilot outputs are described in the evidence but cannot be remeasured from this public dataset.
These are synthetic demo people and a small catalog, not a shopper study or evidence of reduced returns. There is no combined pass rate.
For a future held-out study, select new cases and freeze this protocol before collecting outputs. Keep development and held-out results separate and report all exclusions.
